summary: Direction/angle store helper (thiscall on an audio sample object): copies a 3-int triple from a2 into this+0x58/0x5C/0x60 and a 3-float angle triple from a3 into this+0x64/0x68/0x6C, then computes trig terms from a3[1] (and a3[0] folded through a multiply-by-0.0) and stores them at this+0x70 (cosine-derived), this+0x74 (zero) and this+0x78 (sine-derived). Returns the low dword of the float stored at this+0x78.

operations.description: Copy the 3-int triple: this+0x58 = a2[0], this+0x5C = a2[1], this+0x60 = a2[2].
Copy the 3-float angle triple: this+0x64 = a3[0], this+0x68 = a3[1], this+0x6C = a3[2].
Trig seed terms: v7 = -cos(a3[1]) using the second angle (this+0x68); v9 = -sin(a3[0]) * 0.0 using the first angle (this+0x64), a multiply by literal zero.
Combine terms: v3 = v9 - v7; v4 = sin(a3[1]); v5 = v7 * 0.0 - v4 * 0.0; v8 = v4 - v9. The multiply-by-0.0 terms reduce to zero in floating point.
Store the results: this+0x70 = v3 (cosine-derived), this+0x74 = v5 (zero term), this+0x78 = v8 (sine-derived).
Return result = LODWORD(v8), the low dword of the float stored at this+0x78.
Invoked by AudioSamplePositionVolumeSetter (004071F0) to refresh the sample object's direction/trig terms during position/volume updates.
